_layer: IDENTITY (EXAMPLE). Fixtures for the generic harness in engine/lib/check_cv_tests.py.
_why: The harness is method and ships with the engine; these cases are one person's career facts and do not. Every guardrail should have at least one case that fires and one that must NOT, because a rule you have only tested in the firing direction is a rule you will end up deleting the first time it cries wolf.
_working_rule: Every false positive found on a real package gets added here BEFORE the pattern in guardrails.json is loosened.

_schema.should_fail: true if a guardrail must fire
